publisher: Tactile Entertainment / DataCamp / Kaggle mirror (Yufeng Sui, Rasmus Bååth)
license_and_terms: Public educational dataset distributed for mobile games A/B testing analysis. Permitted for educational and portfolio analysis.
redistribution_status: Excluded from Git by default via .gitignore; local acquisition verified.
assignment_notes: Source documentation reports that players were randomly assigned to gate_30 (control) or gate_40 (treatment) upon installing the game. Server-side randomization logs and random seed are not independently verifiable from the static snapshot.
expected_allocation_notes: Intended treatment fraction is assumed to be 0.50 (50:50 allocation) based on standard game feature A/B testing convention.
retention_definition: retention_1: player returned 1 day after install; retention_7: player returned 7 days after install.
maturity_notes: The public snapshot does not include installation timestamps or cohort cutoff dates; complete 7-day follow-up for late-arriving cohorts is assumed but not timestamp-verified.
unresolved_limitations: No user installation timestamps or geographic/device covariates available in public snapshot.
Original randomization mechanism is reported by source but not independently verifiable.
Maturity and follow-up window completeness cannot be proven without event logs.
Revenue and monetization outcomes are unavailable; gate movement impact on total in-app purchases cannot be directly inferred.
